profile_text.body:
Palantir is a public company, traded as PLTR, founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto. Its site says it builds software that lets organizations integrate their data, decisions, and operations, and it markets itself with the line "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today." The company files with the SEC under CIK 0001321655.

Its tracked AI product is Palantir AIP, listed under Data and Analytics AI. It is described as an enterprise AI platform with Ontology-based governance, a defense and intelligence focus, and influence over high-stakes decisions.

One case is listed: Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware. No MCP servers are recorded for the company.
